methods.candidate_workaround: After a timeout, inspect the index lock and exact staged, unstaged, and untracked counts before deciding whether to retry; terminate only the identified owner-started orphan processes.

methods.recurrence_guard: Run large index updates and bounded post-stage enumeration as separate commands with independent envelopes.
methods.rollback: Award no wrapper credit, avoid a duplicate staging retry until state is inspected, and never remove an unknown lock or terminate an unrelated process.

methods.title: Separate large index updates from bounded post-stage state proof

methods.candidate_workaround: Re-add only the affected generated text files with the repository's normal Git attributes and line-ending configuration, then rerun diff hygiene.

methods.recurrence_guard: Do not disable repository normalization when staging generated text; use output suppression separately from byte normalization.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed diff check and stage no commit until the normalized index blobs pass.
methods.scope_boundary: Generated-text line endings only; no semantic, scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.

methods.rollback: Retain the false wrapper result with zero credit and rerun the underlying check independently.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only wrapper correctness only; no repository, scientific, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Capture each native validation exit code before running later probes
